alternatives.title: Zendaya: three eights, three different features

voice.direction: An engaging editorial face-analysis narrator. Measured, precise and quietly commanding, with warm late-night radio texture and a small spark of playful curiosity. Contained upbeat energy, not comedy or hype. Clear scientific vocabulary, conversational phrasing, approximately 175 words per minute. Light emphasis on contrasts; brief reflective pauses. Speak as an independent analyst, never imitate the person pictured.

alternatives.preview: Zendaya gets eight for her eyes, brows and cheekbones. Same number, three very different things happening in this portrait. Let's open the report.
